questions.question: In your Arista Networks role, how did you work with the BA analyst and client to verify requirements before creating test scenarios and scripts?
You mention designing and developing user stories for the VAP Enhancements project. What information did you include in a user story, and how did you ensure its acceptance criteria were testable?
Describe a time when you translated a business requirement or BRD into a test plan, test cases, and requirements traceability matrix. How did you manage changes to the requirement?
How have you used JIRA, Zephyr, VersionOne, or Rational Quality Management to link requirements, user stories, test cases, defects, and test results?

This role requires coordinating UAT between business testers and IT teams. Walk us through your experience supporting UAT, including how you captured issues, communicated status, and obtained acceptance of test criteria.
What approach have you used to define regression test coverage after a defect fix or new release, and how did you determine that a build was ready for SIT or UAT?

Give an example of a defect or data-validation issue you identified through SQL queries, SAP BI report testing, or web-service testing. How did you document the issue and work with developers through resolution?

How would you facilitate agreement among a product manager, business stakeholders, developers, QA, and external channel or partner-facing teams when they have differing interpretations of a requirement?
Describe the test metrics and status reporting you have prepared for Agile leads, project managers, or clients. Which metrics were most useful for assessing release readiness?

The role involves process documentation and workflow automation for partner, channel, and distributor processes. What methods or artifacts would you use to map an end-to-end process, identify handoffs and controls, and turn the resulting requirements into user stories?
